title: Transfection of Constructs in Diplonemids to Block NHEJ Pathway
author: Binnypreet Kaur1
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.x35fqq6

steps.title: Pre-incubate Diplonema cells
steps.instruction: Pre-incubate Diplonema cells with W7 (5 mg/ml) for 4 hours prior to electroporation.

steps.title: Prepare cell suspension
steps.instruction: Count cells and prepare 5x10^7 cells per construct for nucleofection.

substeps.instruction: Harvest cells by centrifugation at 1300xg for 5 min at room temperature using a Swing Bucket Rotor.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 100ul of AMAXA Human T-cell solution at 4C (prepared by combining 81.8ul of Human T-cell nucleofector solution and 18.2ul Supplement).

steps.title: Prepare DNA and load cuvette
steps.instruction: Prepare the DNA and load the electroporation cuvette.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend 5-10ug of linearized PCR DNA in 10ul of H2O.
Add the DNA into the cuvette containing the cell suspension.
Close the cap and place the cuvette into the electroporator with the metal sides facing towards you.

steps.title: Perform electroporation
steps.instruction: Electroporate the cells using Program X-001.

steps.title: Post-electroporation recovery
steps.instruction: Recover the transfectants in media and incubate.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the entire cell-DNA transfectant into 10ml of Diplonema media (containing chloramphenicol) using disposable micropipettes.
Observe flasks under a microscope immediately.
Incubate flasks at 27C with a shaker for 6-8 hours.

steps.title: Seed cells and apply selection
steps.instruction: Distribute transfectants into 24-well plates and apply puromycin selection.

substeps.instruction: After 6-8 hours, transfer 1ml of electroporated cells into the first well of a 24-well plate to serve as a control (without antibiotics).
Add Puromycin antibiotics to the remaining 9ml of transfectants in the flasks.
Add 1.5ml of electroporated cells into the first row (6 wells) of 24-well plates.
Add 900ul of media containing the selectable drug to the remaining wells.
Perform a 10x serial dilution by transferring 100ul from the first well to the next, continuing down to a lowest concentration of 5x10^2 cells/ml.
Incubate until selection of clones is complete.
